display_name: Venus ruler of the 1st House in the 1st House
description: You are the magnet. Your face, body, voice, posture, taste — these are what the room responds to. Slow, deliberate, sensual presence is your romantic signature; rushed approaches misfire. Partners are drawn to the stillness, the warmth, the curated aesthetic, the unmistakable comfort of being near you. The shadow: the same magnetism that pulls everyone in can become a comfort-trap — when admiration replaces intimacy, the relationship quietly stalls. Choose the partner who sees through the surface.

The shadow: charm used to dodge the conflict will compound the underlying friction.
